Subject: Evidence request — staff training completion and contractor offboards

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well. As part of our annual SIG review we're collecting narrow-scope evidence related to staff security training and contractor offboarding for the accounts we integrate with. Could you please provide the following artifacts for Redwood?

- A CSV or export showing security training completion (course id, employee name, completion date) for all staff who had access to AcmeWorks systems since Jan 1, 2027.
- Evidence that contractors who had access were deprovisioned within 48 hours of last day-of-engagement: logs or screenshots are fine, redacted as needed.
- Any written offboarding checklist you use for contingent workers.

We prefer redacted artifacts in a single ZIP. Deadline: May 11, 2028 so our audit run can include them. If anything is expected to be delayed please flag now.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Security Compliance Manager — AcmeWorks
liam.oconnor@acmeworks.com

- contractor-offboard-logs-redacted.pdf: An extract from our IAM audit for events tagged "deprovision" for contractor user tokens. All email addresses and external contact fields redacted. Includes timestamps and the responsible operator ID (redacted).

2) We cannot share raw IAM operator usernames for privacy; we replaced those with operator_token values.

Attaching the four files to this message. Let me know if Acme needs name-level redaction changes or additional timestamps.

-Kim
